description: Lists rent.dev's provider catalog as compact summaries: each provider's capabilities (offerings, pricing types, interfaces, auth and product capabilities), display-only `summary_verdict`, `agentic` flag, the provenance of its cheapest matched offering and that offering's price row. Read-only; needs no account. A listed provider may be unpriced: its terms may permit display but not comparison (`clause` names that denial and its prices are withheld), no price row may match the filters, or its rows may carry no hourly figure (a GPU row then gives `unpriced_reason`: monthly_rate, no_time_unit or unknown_gpu_count; a per-unit row has `usd` and `unit` but no hourly figure). `include_offerings` carries every matching offering, not just the cheapest. `use` asserts a rights use on providers and figures (default display). `limit` caps providers only. Every offer carries `covers`, `gpu.count`, `region_id` and `comparison_group`: the group names the purchasable unit (GPU model, count, market, pricing type, canonical region and commitment), so two offers are price-comparable exactly when their groups match. `region` accepts the vendor's label or the canonical id; `gpu_count`, `covers` and `figure` narrow the grain.

agentic_only.description: True keeps only providers with a product passing the three-test agentic conjunction.

architecture.description: Keep CPU offerings whose architecture the vendor states as this value.

capability.description: A capability the provider or one of its products lists, e.g. `gpu`, `serverless`, `sdk`, `mcp`, `api_key`.

comparison_group.description: Keep offerings in exactly this comparison group; `cheapest_offering.comparison_group` names it, and the group's other offers are its comparable peers.

covers.description: Keep offerings whose figure covers this unit: `gpu` one GPU, `node`/`instance` a whole node or instance, `gpu_line_item` a fractional GPU line.

cpu.description: The CPU capacity class (`shared`, `dedicated`) or the vendor's product label for a CPU offering (e.g. `macos`), matched without regard to case.

figure.description: Keep offerings whose figure was produced this way (`listed`, `floor`, …).

gpu.description: Canonical GPU model id (`h100-sxm-80gb`) or the vendor's own label.

gpu_count.description: Keep GPU offerings whose `gpu.count` (GPUs per priced unit) is exactly this many; `gpu_count=1` asks for single-GPU offers only.

include_offerings.description: True carries every matching offering of the listed providers, not just the cheapest.

max_usd_per_hour.description: Keep offerings whose hourly figure (`usd_per_gpu_hour` on a GPU row, else `usd_per_hour`) is at most this many USD.

max_usd_per_vcpu_hour.description: Keep CPU offerings whose `usd_per_vcpu_hour` is at most this many USD.

region.description: A region label or a canonical region id (`us-east-1`), matched without regard to case; either spelling finds every offer in that place.

use.description: The use the answer asserts: only providers permitting it are listed and only figures whose `publish_mask` allows it are shown. Default `display`.

name: rent_list_providers

attribution.description: Obligations owed beside the listed providers' figures; show them with the prices.

catalog_version.description: SHA-256 of the committed catalog artifact.

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp of the catalog fold.

offerings.description: Every matching offering of the listed providers, when `include_offerings` is true.

comparison_group.description: Stable id of the comparable unit: GPU model, GPU count, market, pricing_type, canonical region and commitment. Two offers share a group exactly when their prices are comparable; null on a row that prices no GPU.

covers.description: What the figure covers: `gpu` one GPU, `node`/`instance` a whole node or instance, `gpu_line_item` a fractional GPU line.

read_at.description: UTC date the vendor's price was read.

region.description: The region label the vendor states.

region_id.description: Canonical region id the label folds to (`us-east-1`); either spelling answers a `region` filter. Null when no region is stated or the label is unmapped.

unpriced_reason.description: Why there is no GPU hourly figure (`monthly_rate`, `no_time_unit`, `unknown_gpu_count`).

usd.description: USD per `per_quantity` of `quantity_unit` per `time_unit`, as the vendor states it.

usd_per_gpu_hour.description: Price of one GPU per hour, normalised across node and instance rows; the comparable figure.

usd_per_hour.description: Price of the vendor's quantity unit per hour; null without an hourly figure. On a row that prices a whole node or instance this is that unit's price, not one GPU's; `usd_per_gpu_hour` is the comparable per-GPU figure.

usd_per_vcpu_hour.description: One vCPU's price per hour, normalised across VM, per-core and per-vCPU rows.

vcpu_unpriced_reason.description: Why there is no vCPU hourly figure (`monthly_rate`, `no_time_unit`, `unknown_vcpu_count`).

cheapest_offering.description: The matched offering with the lowest hourly figure, or null when none has one.

clause.description: The `compare` denial that withholds this provider's prices; null when its terms permit comparison.

provenance.description: The provenance of `cheapest_offering`; null when it is null.

unpriced_reason.description: Why no hourly figure was found, when a matched row states one; null when a price was found or no reason is stated.

truncated.description: True when a requested list was cut at its ceiling.

title: List providers
